text:
morgan: Quick sync — unified dashboard tradeoffs. Two big customer asks: per-route cost breakdown (Acme) and trace hooks to link error spikes to model variants (BetaBank). Need to decide MVP surface and launch criteria. Thoughts?

jess: +1. My baseline MVP: dashboards with token cost per-route, 90/95 latency P50/P95, and a simple error rate heatmap. Minimal tracing: attach trace_id in logs and UI link to traces in jaeger. That keeps infra lift low.

arjun: Agree. For trace hooks, we can add model.variant tag at request start and capture it in spans. Low-effort: propagate `x-model-variant` header into traces. Perf impact minimal.

peggy: Customers also ask for quota burn visibility grouped by embeddings vs generation — can we add that to MVP? Acme insists on embedding cost split.

sam: We can compute cost split from existing billing logs + metrics. Might need a nightly job to backfill; realtime will be harder. Suggest MVP: near-real-time (~5m lag) + nightly accuracy for historical.

liz: Launch criteria proposal: 1) Cost per-route and per-capability (embed/gen) available in UI for last 7d. 2) Trace link from error event -> trace with model variant tag present for 90% of sampled requests. 3) Alerts for error rate regressions on top 3 routes. 4) Docs & quickstart for customer config.

morgan: Good. What's the engineering estimate for MVP?

arjun: Rough: 3 sprints (6 engineers) to wire metrics, backfill job, add UI panels, and trace propagation. If we cut per-capability split to nightly only, we can do 2 sprints.

peggy: Customer negotiation note: Acme can accept nightly split for GA if we promise realtime in next quarter. BetaBank cares more about trace->model mapping for compliance.

devops-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary for trace-prop feature next week on dedicated. See: https://deploys.redwood.example/canary/123

jess: Also need to define sampling policy. Default 1% won't capture enough errors for low-volume routes. Propose: default 1% + error-based sampling to 100% for errors.

sam: +1. Implementation: set sampler = probabilistic(0.01) then if status >=500 or error_flag true -> force sample.

```yaml
sampling:
  default_prob: 0.01
  rules:
    - condition: status >= 500
      action: sample_always
```

liz: Acceptance test checklist: `cost_panel shows per-capability numbers`, `trace link opens jaeger with x-model-variant param`, `error-alert fires on injected 5xx`.

morgan: Action items: 1) arjun to draft trace header plan + PR by Thu. 2) sam to prototype cost-split job & perf doc. 3) jess + liz to design dashboard mocks and acceptance tests. 4) peggy to communicate GA expectation to Acme/BetaBank. I'll update roadmap slide.

peggy: ack. I'll email Acme & BetaBank with compromises. cc @morgan

jess: I'll add the mock to Figma and drop link here when ready :art:

morgan: Thanks all. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
